frozen_candidate_root_contribution: The root contributes RELINQUISHMENT-INTO-REMAINING: the agent's withdrawal of holding/acting-upon/attending-to an object, such that the object is simply left standing in whatever state it is in, apart from the agent, without further intervention. It marks non-retention (letting-remain / letting-be), not motion, seizure, or destruction; direction is always agent-releases → object-persists-on-its-own.

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: The root contributes RELINQUISHMENT-INTO-REMAINING: the agent's withdrawal of holding/acting-upon/attending-to an object, such that the object is simply left standing in whatever state it is in, apart from the agent, without further intervention. It marks non-retention (letting-remain / letting-be), not motion, seizure, or destruction; direction is always agent-releases → object-persists-on-its-own.
internal_discovery.plain_explanation:
Every one of the 45 tokens is the same defective Form-I verb (ذَرْ / يَذَرُ / نَذَرُ / تَذَرُونَ etc.) and in each the residue "release the object to remain as it is" is directly recoverable, across five observable sense-clusters that differ only by object and context:

(1) Leave persons in their present state / to their own devices — the object stays put and the agent ceases involvement: 10:11 "فَنَذَرُ ٱلَّذِينَ ... فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ" (leave them wandering in their transgression), 6:110, 7:186 (same frame), 15:3 "ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟", 23:54 "فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ", 43:83/70:42/52:45 "فَذَرْهُمْ ... حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟", 6:91 "ذَرْهُمْ فِى خَوْضِهِمْ", 6:112/6:137 "فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ", 6:70/7:180 "ذَرِ/ذَرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ...", 3:179 "لِيَذَرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ" (leave-in-that-state, negated). Requests to "leave me alone with X" are the same withdrawal, addressee-directed: 73:11 "وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ", 74:11 "ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ", 68:44 "فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ"; and permission-to-act framings 40:26 "ذَرُونِىٓ أَقْتُلْ" (leave me [free] to kill), 48:15 "ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ", 9:86 "ذَرْنَا نَكُن مَّعَ ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ" — in each the speaker asks to be released/left so as to remain in a chosen state or act.

(2) Leave an object standing in a specified physical state: 11:64/7:73 "فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِىٓ أَرْضِ ٱللَّهِ" (leave the she-camel to graze), 12:47 "فَذَرُوهُ فِى سُنۢبُلِهِ" (leave the grain in its ear), 20:106 "فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا" (leave it a level plain), 4:129 "فَتَذَرُوهَا كَٱلْمُعَلَّقَةِ" (leave her as one suspended). Object clearly persists in a state after the agent stops acting.

(3) Give up / cease engaging with a practice or thing (directive to stop holding it): 2:278 "وَذَرُوا۟ مَا بَقِىَ مِنَ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓا۟", 62:9 "وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلْبَيْعَ", 6:120 "وَذَرُوا۟ ظَٰهِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَبَاطِنَهُ".

(4) Culpable forsaking/neglect (same residue; the negative valence is supplied by the object + context, not the root): 26:166 "وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم", 37:125 "وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ", 7:70 "وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا", 71:23 (×2) "لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ ... وَدًّا", 75:21 "وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ", 76:27 "وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا". Note 71:23 and 37:125 are the SAME verb whose object is idols/God — proving the valence is not in the root.

(5) Leave-behind by death / leave-remaining, incl. negated "leave nothing": 2:234 & 2:240 "وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَٰجًا" (leave surviving wives). Survival/sparing: 21:89 "لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا" (do not leave me solitary), 71:26 "لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ... دَيَّارًا" (do not leave a single dweller), 71:27 "إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟", 7:127 (×2) "أَتَذَرُ مُوسَىٰ ... وَيَذَرَكَ وَءَالِهَتَكَ" (will you leave Moses free... and he leave/abandon you). The apparent "destruction" tokens are simply this residue under negation — nothing is let-remain: 51:42 "مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ" (leaves nothing it strikes), 74:28 "لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ" (spares not, leaves not). Here 'leaving/remaining' is exactly what is denied, confirming the residue by its negation.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: Subtracted layers: (a) FORM — the root is morphologically uniform (all 45 = Form-I, a defective verb attested only in imperfect/imperative; no perfect, verbal noun, or participle in the data), so no derivational sense-shift can account for the range; the constancy of form beside a single constant residue is itself strong evidence. (b) CONSTRUCTION — imperative "ذَرْ/ذَرُوا۟" adds directivity (do the leaving); "ذَرْنِى وَ..." adds the reflexive "leave me [together] with"; the frame "يَذَرُ ... فِى [طُغْيَان/خَوْض/غَمْرَة]" (fī + state) supplies the LOCUS in which the object is left; "عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ" (71:26) supplies domain; negation (لَا تَذَرْ / مَا تَذَرُ / لَا يَذَرُ) flips remaining→none-remaining — all of these are added by the frame, not the root. (c) PARTICIPANTS — object may be persons, spouses, gods, God, usury, trade, grain, a she-camel, the Hereafter; the "abandon-God vs leave-camel-to-graze" contrast shows moral valence tracks the object, not the root. (d) CONTEXT — legal (2:234/240/278), eschatological (75:21, 76:27, 74:28), narrative/prophetic (7:127, 71:x), polemical (6:x). After subtracting all four, the invariant remaining everywhere is "agent ceases holding/acting-on the object → object left to remain in its state."
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 51:42 "مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ" and 74:28 "لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ" appear opposite to the core, since the salient event is total DESTRUCTION, not gentle leaving. They reconcile cleanly under layer-subtraction: the verb here is NEGATED, and what is negated is precisely "letting-remain" — the wind/Saqar lets nothing persist. The destruction is contributed by the surrounding clause (جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ) and by the parallel لَا تُبْقِى; the root still means only "leave-to-remain," now denied. Thus the hardest cases actually corroborate the residue by exhibiting its negation.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: The strongest alternative is a core of "ABANDON / FORSAKE (culpable neglect)." It fits the polemical and neglect tokens (37:125, 26:166, 71:23, 75:21) well. But internal evidence arbitrates against it: the identical verb governs approved/neutral objects where no forsaking is culpable — leaving the she-camel to graze (11:64/7:73), leaving grain in its ear for storage (12:47), leaving surviving wives (2:234/240), and being commanded by God to "leave" wrongdoers (6:112 etc.). A "forsake/neglect" core would have to import negative valence that these tokens lack, whereas the neutral "relinquish-into-remaining" core covers both the neutral and the culpable readings, with the moral coloring supplied by object+context. A second alternative, "let-remain / not-remove," is essentially my candidate; the destruction tokens (51:42, 74:28) confirm that "remaining" — not "forsaking" — is the semantic pivot, since it is remaining that gets negated.
internal_discovery.distinctiveness_note: Nearest neighbors: ت ر ك (taraka, "to leave/abandon" — its natural suppletive partner, since w*r supplies only the imperfect/imperative and lacks the perfect), ه ج ر (hajara, "to forsake by moving away / sever"), and و د ع (wadaʿa, "to let/leave off"). Distinction visible even internally: w*r foregrounds the OBJECT'S continued REMAINING-IN-STATE after the agent's release (fī ṭughyānihim, qāʿan ṣafṣafan, taʾkul, ka-l-muʿallaqah, dayyārā) — the thing stays put while the agent withdraws engagement; ه ج ر would foreground the agent's own spatial/relational SEPARATION-away-from the object. Falsifiability condition: if any confirmed w*r occurrence required the sense "actively take/seize/carry-off the object" or "the agent moves away from a stationary object" (rather than "release the object to remain"), the residue would fail. No such occurrence exists in the 45. Caveat: sharp separation from ت ر ك cannot be fully adjudicated on internal data alone, since the two are near-synonymous in the "leave" sense.
internal_discovery.rationale: A single non-empty contribution — "relinquishment-into-remaining: agent withdraws holding/action, object is left standing in its state" — is surface-recoverable in all 45 occurrences, with a determinate direction (release → persistence) and morphological uniformity (one defective Form-I verb). The five sense-clusters (leave-in-state, leave-in-physical-state, give-up-a-practice, culpable-forsaking, leave-behind/spare) differ only in object and construction, all of which are separable layers; subtracting them leaves the identical invariant. The hardest cases (51:42, 74:28 "leaves nothing") do not contradict but confirm the residue via negation of "remaining." The competing "forsake/neglect" core is defeated internally by neutral/approved objects that carry no culpability, showing valence lives in the object+context, not the root. Unity holds against every occurrence without forcing; inconsistent_refs is empty. The one genuine soft spot is that its near-synonymy with ت ر ك cannot be sharply arbitrated from internal Qur'anic data alone, but this does not weaken the internal unity, which is clean and directionally determinate — hence STRONG rather than MODERATE.

adversarial_verification.notes: Adversarial sweep of all 45 tokens found NO genuine failing occurrence. All 45 are the same defective Form-I verb (ذَرْ/يَذَرُ/نَذَرُ/تَذَرُونَ...) meaning leave/let; there is no positive-motion, seizure, acquisition, or non-negated-destruction sense anywhere, so no homonymy or real semantic split exists for the candidate to bridge. The residue "agent ceases holding/acting/attending → object persists on its own in its state" is recoverable in every token. Hardest cases and resolutions: (1) 20:106 "فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا" looks causative-resultative (state seems agent-produced), but context 105→106 is that God pulverizes the mountains and leaves the ground bare — ceasing action, object persists bare; standard resultative "leave as," not a failure. (2) 4:129 "كَٱلْمُعَلَّقَةِ" = leave-in-imposed-state via neglect; covered. (3) The permission/hortative cluster (40:26 ذَرُونِىٓ, 48:15 ذَرُونَا, 9:86 ذَرْنَا; "leave me with" 73:11/74:11/68:44) is where the "object persists" residue is thinnest — the verb tilts toward a permission auxiliary "let me/us" — but it is still recoverable (addressee withdraws intervention; speaker left free to remain/act) and not contradicted. Strong pro-unity evidence: the candidate makes a falsifiable prediction that "destruction" tokens can occur only under negation, and both 51:42 "مَا تَذَرُ" and 74:28 "لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ" are indeed negated ("leaves nothing"), confirming residue by its denial. Valence flip is proven object-driven, not root-driven: 71:23 (forbidden to leave idols) vs 37:125 (blamed for leaving God) is the identical verb with opposite valence. Neighbor-root contrast: profile discriminates cleanly against أخذ (seize), قتل/دمّر (destroy), and motion roots, and correctly excludes non-negated destruction. Sole caveat, flagged for honesty: w*r is a suppletive near-synonym of ت ر ك (taraka supplies its perfect), so the contribution does not discriminate against ترك — but that is because they form one paradigm/synonym pair, not because the profile is a vague blob; the profile is specific (non-retention / letting-remain) and discriminates against genuine neighbor roots, so distinctiveness holds. Falsifiable = true (clear failure condition — any non-negated positive-motion/seizure/destruction token — and none is met).

occurrence_dispositions.note: فَنَذَرُ ٱلَّذِينَ ... فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ — God ceases intervening, leaving persons to persist in their transgression; residue 'let-remain in present state' present.
فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِىٓ أَرْضِ ٱللَّهِ — leave the she-camel standing/grazing; agent withdraws, object persists in its state.
فَذَرُوهُ فِى سُنۢبُلِهِ — leave the grain in its ear; non-retention, object left as-is.
ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ — leave them to eat/enjoy; addressee ceases involvement, object left to its own devices.
نَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا — leave the wrongdoers remaining there kneeling; agent-releases → object-persists frame.
فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا — leave it (the earth) a level plain; object left standing in a specified state.
لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا — 'do not leave me solitary'; negated let-remain, i.e. do not leave me persisting alone; residue confirmed by negation.
فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ — leave them in their confusion for a time; withdrawal, object persists in state.
وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم — you forsake what God created for you; culpable neglect = ceasing to hold/attend; negative valence supplied by object, not root.
وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَٰجًا — leave surviving wives (by death); leave-behind / let-remain sense.
وَيَذَرُونَ أَزْوَٰجًا — same leave-behind-by-death frame; wives left remaining.
وَذَرُوا۟ مَا بَقِىَ مِنَ ٱلرِّبَوٰا۟ — give up / cease holding what remains of usury; relinquishment of a practice.
وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ — you forsake the Best of Creators; same verb whose object is God (cf. 71:23 idols), proving valence external to root.
مَّا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَذَرَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ — negated leave-in-that-state; God will not let believers remain as they are; residue via negation.
ذَرُونِىٓ أَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ — 'leave me [free] to kill Moses'; addressee-directed release so speaker persists in chosen act.
فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ — leave them to their idle discourse; withdrawal, object left in state.
ذَرُونَا نَتَّبِعْكُمْ — 'leave us [free] to follow you'; permission-to-act release, speaker left to remain in chosen course.
فَتَذَرُوهَا كَٱلْمُعَلَّقَةِ — leave her as one suspended; object left standing in a specified state.
مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ — 'leaves nothing it comes upon'; negated let-remain — the leaving/remaining is exactly what is denied; residue confirmed by negation.
فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ — leave them until they meet their Day; withdrawal, object persists on its own.
وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلْبَيْعَ — give up / leave off trade; relinquishment of a practice.
فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ — 'leave me [alone] with the one who denies'; addressee-directed withdrawal.
وَنَذَرُهُمْ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ — leave them wandering in transgression; cease-involvement, object persists in state.
فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ — leave them and what they fabricate; withdrawal, object left as-is.
وَذَرُوا۟ ظَٰهِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَبَاطِنَهُ — give up outward and inward sin; relinquishment of a thing/practice.
فَذَرْهُمْ وَمَا يَفْتَرُونَ — same frame as 6:112; leave them with what they fabricate.
وَذَرِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ لَعِبًا — leave those who took their religion as play; cease attending, object left to itself.
ثُمَّ ذَرْهُمْ فِى خَوْضِهِمْ يَلْعَبُونَ — leave them in their vain discourse; withdrawal, object persists in state.
فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ — leave them to their idle talk; same as 43:83 frame.
لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ — 'do not give up your gods'; negated relinquishment; object is idols (cf. 37:125 God), valence external to root.
وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا — 'and do not give up Wadd'; same negated relinquishment, second object.
لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ... دَيَّارًا — 'do not leave a single dweller on the earth'; negated let-remain/sparing; residue confirmed by negation.
إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ — 'if You leave them, they will mislead'; let-remain, object persists to act on its own.
وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ — 'leave me [alone] with the deniers'; addressee-directed withdrawal.
ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ — 'leave me with the one I created'; addressee-directed withdrawal, same frame.
لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ — 'spares not, leaves not'; negated let-remain paired with abqā; residue is exactly what is denied.
وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ — you forsake the Hereafter; culpable neglect = ceasing to attend; valence from object.
وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا — they leave behind them a heavy Day; leave-behind / let-remain sense.
وَيَذَرَكَ وَءَالِهَتَكَ — 'and he leave/abandon you and your gods'; cease-holding, object left on its own.
أَتَذَرُ مُوسَىٰ وَقَوْمَهُ — 'will you leave Moses and his people [free]'; release so object persists to act.
وَذَرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ يُلْحِدُونَ فِىٓ أَسْمَٰٓئِهِ — leave those who blaspheme His names; cease attending, object left to itself.
وَيَذَرُهُمْ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ — leave them wandering in transgression; same as 10:11/6:110 frame.
وَنَذَرَ مَا كَانَ يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا — 'and forsake what our fathers worshipped'; relinquishment/ceasing-to-hold a practice.
فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِىٓ أَرْضِ ٱللَّهِ — leave the she-camel to graze; same as 11:64; object left standing in its state.
ذَرْنَا نَكُن مَّعَ ٱلْقَٰعِدِينَ — 'leave us [to] be among those who stay behind'; permission-to-remain release.
